description: Homepage only: Facebook, Instagram, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Telegram, Snapchat, Pinterest, Threads, GitHub, TripAdvisor, Google Business links plus WhatsApp chat links, with handles. Share buttons are excluded. Example: url 'https://example.com'. Response: result with emails[] (email, source, role), phones[] (e164, international, region, type, source), whatsapp[], social{platform: [url, handle]}, addresses[], organization{}, pages[] (what was fetched, status) and summary{}, plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[] and a disclaimer. Charged per page actually fetched; failed fetches are free. URLs are not logged.
name: find_social_profiles
title: Find a website's social-media profiles
